components.note:
DriveLink uses these Qt modules: Core, Gui, Network, OpenGL, Qml, QmlCore, QmlMeta, QmlModels, QmlWorkerScript, Quick, Quick Controls 2 (Basic style), Quick Dialogs 2, Quick Effects, Quick Layouts, Quick Shapes, Quick Templates 2, Svg and Labs FolderListModel, with the Qt plugins and QML modules they need (the windows and offscreen platforms, the gif, ico, jpeg and svg image formats, SVG icons, TLS and network information).
Qt is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 3 (LGPLv3), which incorporates the GNU General Public License version 3; both texts are in the appendix. Qt is dynamically linked: its DLLs sit in the installation folder next to the DriveLink programs and may be replaced by a modified, compatible build of Qt 6.12, which DriveLink then loads. The complete corresponding Qt source code is available from https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.12/6.12.0/single/ , and a copy is available on request from the publisher. DriveLink's own code is not licensed under the LGPL; it is proprietary, see LICENSE.txt.
The components listed next are third-party code bundled inside the Qt libraries, as recorded in the SBOM files that Qt 6.12.0 ships (qtbase, qtdeclarative, qtsvg). Qt's SBOM does not say which parts of qtbase ship in a given Windows build, so every part that can be in the deployed Qt6Core, Qt6Gui, Qt6Network, Qt6Qml, Qt6QuickLayouts or the qwindows plugin is listed (a superset). Linux-only, test-only and not-deployed parts (D-Bus, X11 helpers, KDE, Catch2, SQLite, the Material style) are omitted.
